title: Structural relaxation of A₃C₆₀
action: For each compound (K3C60, Rb3C60, Cs3C60), perform DFT structural relaxation using LDA pseudopotentials. Optimize lattice constants and atomic positions. For Cs3C60, relax under a pressure of 7 kbar. Save the relaxed structures.
description: Intermediate step required to obtain the relaxed geometry used in subsequent calculations.

title: Γ-point H_g phonon frequency identification
action: Using the relaxed structures, run a density functional perturbation theory (DFPT) phonon calculation at the Γ point. Identify the eight fivefold-degenerate H_g-derived modes (Hg1–Hg8) for each compound. Compute the average frequency (cm⁻¹) of each degenerate branch and write the results to /app/outputs/phonon_frequencies.json.
description: Scored artifact containing the calculated Γ-point H_g phonon frequencies for K3C60, Rb3C60, and Cs3C60.
output_schema: JSON object with top-level keys 'K3C60', 'Rb3C60', 'Cs3C60'. Each value is an object with keys 'Hg1' through 'Hg8' whose values are numeric frequencies (cm⁻¹).
